decision: held: conditional per Dr. Pham's fifth ruling; exact material verified (both studies in 22428137 used AstaREAL Oil 50F, Fuji Chemical Industry, 3 mg astaxanthin per softgel) but independent support is missing: the record's only source was written entirely by Fuji Chemical staff and no independent AstaReal skin trial is among its references
summary: The publisher PDF (CC-BY-SA) was read in full and confirms both studies used AstaREAL Oil 50F softgels. Credit is conditional on the exact material and independent support; the material holds, but all authors are Fuji Chemical staff and the record has no independent AstaReal trial, so it stays held. On the evidence itself, the women's study is open-label and uncontrolled with topical co-treatment, and the men's 18-vs-18 study designates no primary endpoint and reports selected wrinkle, elasticity and TEWL changes. Both contexts are approved as non-crediting; no record-level change is made. The earlier citation correction (31221944 excluded) is retained.

Publisher full Methods/Results inspected 27 October 2026: no unique primary outcome designated. AstaREAL Oil 50 F 5%H. pluvialis extract in canola oil softgel 3 mg astaxanthin each. Women combined oral+topical uncontrolled; no isolated oral causality inferred.

No credit: 36 men (18 per arm) for 6 weeks with no designated primary endpoint; the text reports improvements 'compared to the start' while Figures 9-12 cite unpaired t-tests, so a placebo-separated effect is not clearly established; only 2 of 6 wrinkle parameters, elasticity and TEWL improved. All authors are affiliated with Fuji Chemical Industry, the maker.
